title: Not All Asians are the Same: A Disaggregated Approach to Identifying Anti-Asian Racism in Social Media
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational identification of anti-Asian racism and hate speech patterns on social media. While its topic modeling identifies specific themes related to religious groups (e.g., Hindu-Muslim conflicts) and includes a 'Blasphemy' topic, these are findings from data mining rather than a dedicated evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or ethics themselves.
